# no audit file is created unless --audit-log is passed
age -r age1xmwwc06ly3ee5rytxm9mflaz2u56jjj36s0mypdrwsvlul66mv4q47ryef -o test.age input
age -d -i key.txt test.age
cmp stdout input
! exists audit.jsonl

# --audit-log can't be used in encryption mode
! age --audit-log audit.jsonl -r age1xmwwc06ly3ee5rytxm9mflaz2u56jjj36s0mypdrwsvlul66mv4q47ryef -o x.age input
stderr '--audit-log can''t be used in encryption mode'
! exists audit.jsonl

# successful decryption records the identity attempt and the file-level outcome
age -d -i key.txt --audit-log audit.jsonl test.age
cmp stdout input
! stderr .
grep '"v":1' audit.jsonl
grep '"kind":"identity".*"identity":"age1xmwwc06ly3ee5rytxm9mflaz2u56jjj36s0mypdrwsvlul66mv4q47ryef".*"identity_type":"x25519".*"file":"test.age".*"result":"success"' audit.jsonl
grep '"kind":"file".*"file":"test.age".*"result":"success"' audit.jsonl
# the log contains no secret key material and no absolute paths
! grep 'AGE-SECRET-KEY' audit.jsonl
! grep '"file":"/' audit.jsonl
! grep $WORK audit.jsonl

# a wrong identity is recorded as a mismatch, the file as missing recipients
age -r age12phkzssndd5axajas2h74vtge62c86xjhd6u9anyanqhzvdg6sps0xthgl -o wrong.age input
! age -d -i key.txt --audit-log wrong.jsonl wrong.age
stderr 'no identity matched any of the recipients'
grep '"kind":"identity".*"failure":"identity_mismatch"' wrong.jsonl
grep '"kind":"file".*"failure":"missing_recipient"' wrong.jsonl
! grep 'AGE-SECRET-KEY' wrong.jsonl
! grep $WORK wrong.jsonl

# a corrupt file is recorded as corrupt
! age -d -i key.txt --audit-log corrupt.jsonl corrupt.age
grep '"kind":"file".*"failure":"corrupt_file"' corrupt.jsonl

# an unreadable input is recorded as read_denied
! age -d -i key.txt --audit-log denied.jsonl missing.age
stderr 'failed to open input file'
grep '"kind":"file".*"failure":"read_denied"' denied.jsonl

# an unwritable audit log only warns and doesn't affect decryption
age -d -i key.txt --audit-log nosuchdir/audit.jsonl test.age
stderr 'warning: cannot open audit log'
cmp stdout input
! exists nosuchdir/audit.jsonl

# passphrase decryption records the scrypt identity, a wrong passphrase is a mismatch
[!linux] [!darwin] skip # no pty support
stdin input
ttyin terminal
age -p -o pass.age
! stderr .
ttyin terminal
age -d --audit-log pass.jsonl pass.age
cmp stdout input
grep '"identity":"scrypt".*"result":"success"' pass.jsonl
! grep 'password' pass.jsonl
ttyin wrong
! age -d --audit-log passwrong.jsonl pass.age
stderr 'incorrect passphrase'
grep '"failure":"identity_mismatch"' passwrong.jsonl
! grep 'PASSWORD' passwrong.jsonl

-- input --
test
-- key.txt --
# created: 2021-02-02T13:09:43+01:00
# public key: age1xmwwc06ly3ee5rytxm9mflaz2u56jjj36s0mypdrwsvlul66mv4q47ryef
AGE-SECRET-KEY-1EGTZVFFV20835NWYV6270LXYVK2VKNX2MMDKWYKLMGR48UAWX40Q2P2LM0
-- corrupt.age --
this is not an age file at all
-- terminal --
password
password
-- wrong --
PASSWORD
